Manuscript land ownership survey map of western portion of Edgewood, Harford County, Md.

Manuscript land ownership survey map of western portion of Edgewood, Harford County, Md. Shows real-property lines, measurements, orientations, acreages, tract names, and names of landowners. Pen-and-ink (india ink) on tracing linen. Landowners' names written in more than 1 hand. Condition imperfect: Greatly use-worn, fold-lined, widely soiled, stained in small areas, torn at edges, torn at fold lines. Includes notes. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Gift; Kurt J. Kuhn; Aug. 2011.
